messages:
devon: Heads up — cross-repo merge needed for the telemetry change. API PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/api/pull/678 adds optional `trace_id` in responses. SDK, console, and helm need coordination.

sanjay: @devon I'll review the API PR today. Is the new field optional/backwards-compatible? :eyes: 

devon: It's optional — non-breaking. SDK needs a small deserialization change and a new helper: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/142

olivia: Console PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/310 is ready but failing one integration test after API change. CI log:
```
error: Unexpected key 'trace_id' in response parsing
  at parseResponse (src/services/telemetry.ts:47:12)
```

devon: That'll be fixed by SDK bump. @sanjay can you confirm SDK semver? We can do a patch release once API is merged.

sanjay: SDK change is a patch (0.12.3 -> 0.12.4). No public API changes. I'll sign off after API merges. :thumbsup: 

maria: Helm chart needs runtime image tag update and a values flag for telemetry. I'll create a chart PR after runtime image is published. Can we agree on merge order?

devon: Proposed order: 1) merge API PR 2) cut API version tag/deploy (canary) 3) merge SDK PR + release 4) bump SDK in console PR and merge 5) runtime image build + merge 6) helm chart bump & deploy. Thoughts?

olivia: Works for console. Need a short quiet window for the console canary (15m) to monitor session replay traces.

maria: Helm can be last. I'll wait for runtime image tag like `runtime:sha-<short>`.

build-bot: CI status — api#678: success, sdk#142: pending, console#310: failing (integration), runtime build: queued

ci-bot: api#678 deployed to canary at https://canary.redwood.local (ver: api-2024.11.2-canary)

sanjay: Reviewing api#678 now, will post comments if any. If green, I'll merge and trigger SDK release flow.

devon: Thanks all. @olivia once SDK release is available, please rebase console branch and trigger the canary. I'll coordinate rollout times (aiming for 11:30 PT).

olivia: Will do. Rebase and re-run tests once SDK 0.12.4 is published.

maria: I'll open the helm PR draft and link the runtime image placeholder; will update tag after runtime merge. :white_check_mark: 

devon: If anyone hits blockers ping here. Otherwise I'll merge api#678 after sanjay's green review and announce merge time.
